inlines.v: FOP, noun [The Latin voppa, a senseless fellow, is evidently from the same root, with the sense of emptiness or lightness.] A vain man of weak understanding and much ostentation; one whose ambition is to gain admiration by showy dress and pertness; a gay trifling man; a coxcomb.
